decision: Resolve window placement in the reducer, from a placement request on window.open, instead of in the consumer from a state snapshot
why: openNewNote awaits a database write before opening, so every note in one burst placed against the same stale canvas
evidence: Live app: four seeded notes all at rect 210.588,400
result: Polkadot deletes its own getPlacedRect; staleness is now structurally unreachable

decision: Let the vacancy search grow outward past bounds instead of returning an occupied rect
why: With the library rail open the content region was 512x388, which fits exactly one 360x240 note, so the candidate grid had one cell
evidence: Live app: notes still landed on each other after the reducer fix
result: Four notes open at 423,995 / 731 / 467 / 203 with no overlap

decision: Reveal a window the canvas placed, replacing the detail-level navigation heuristic
why: A placed window can land off screen, which is the cost of preferring free space; the already-open branch already revealed
evidence: Vacancy search can now return a rect outside the viewport
result: Opening a note always shows the note, by either branch

decision: Skip the camera move when the revealed window is already fully visible
why: revealWindow recentred unconditionally while directional focus, three lines above it, checked visibility first
evidence: Always-reveal on open made the inconsistency visible on every note open
result: Guard test fails when the check is removed; opening a visible note leaves the camera still

decision: Drop the accent tint from the active window header, use a neutral surface
why: The token mixed 9% of the warm orange accent into the surface, so the focused header read brown on a neutral ground
evidence: User flagged it from the running app; accent underline and raised shadow already name the active window
result: --surface-active oklch(0.225 0.004 129), confirmed live as the header background

decision: Clamp zoomed-out note previews with pretext instead of one CSS-truncated line
why: A card showed title plus one clipped line whatever its size, so scanning many notes showed least when it mattered most
evidence: Live app: 90x60 card 2 lines, 126x84 three, 162x108 four; wrapping breaks mid-phrase where CSS could not
result: Cards read as previews; per-zoom cost is arithmetic, one prepare per note

decision: Give the summary renderer the size of the box it draws into
why: A consumer fitting content had to rebuild the header and border maths the canvas already did, and would drift when chrome metrics changed
evidence: renderSummary received the window but not the body extent
result: bodySize on the render context; Polkadot reads it instead of recomputing
